7.description: Unbounded Drain Life Legendary Mystic Enchantment will now correctly behave and show as epic in the Mystic Enchantment collection.
Unbounded Mind Flay is now an Epic Mystic Enchants, down from Legendary, but it now has a max target cap of 5.
Ice Prism Shatter, the proc from using Holy spells on targets affected by Ice Prism from Snowblind now hits up to 5 targets within 8 yards.
Fixed an issue where Ice Prism did no damage at level 20.
Fixed an issue where Prayer of Preservation only applied Preservation to 2 targets instead of 5 targets.
Unbounded Drain Life now heals for 75% of the damage dealt, changed from 100%.

1.description: Fixed an issue where the Brutal Impact capstone worked versus players.
[Pending Restart] [Area 52][Alar] Fixed an issue where Shadowstep could have lower than intended cooldown.
[Pending Restart] [Malganis] Charge can now be reactivated for up to 3 seconds after being cast to Charge again.
[Pending Restart] Heroic Fury now costs 1 epic slot, changed from 2. It now has a 50 second cooldown, changed from 60.
[Pending Restart] [New Capstone] Improved Intercept - Increase the range of your Intercept by 5 yards.
[Pending Restart] Improved Intercept is now a 2 point talent, changed from 3. It now reduces the cooldown of intercept by 5/10 sec, changed from 4/7/10 sec.
[Pending Restart] Heroic Leap now has a 45 sec cooldown, changed from 50.
[Pending Restart] Intensify Rage no longer reduces the cooldown of Heroic Fury.
[Pending Restart] Thunderstorm now costs 2 Legendary Essence, changed from 1.
[Pending Restart] Firestarter now increases Flamestrike damage by 10% versus players, changed from 20%.
[Pending Restart] Voidwalker's Sacrifice now absorbs 10% less damage.
[Pending Restart] Toughness now reduces damage taken while Shamanistic Rage is active by 4/7/10%, changed from 7/14/20%.
[Pending Restart] Improved Renew now increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 10/20/30%, changed from 7/14/20%.
[Pending Restart] Renew has had its healing reduced by 8% baseline. (Together with its talent buff it results in no overall healing change when invested into it.)
[Pending Restart] Improved Rejuvenation now increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 10/20/30%, changed from 7/14/20%.
[Pending Restart] Rejuvenation has had its healing reduced by 8% baseline. (Together with its talent buff it results in no overall healing change when invested into it.)
[Pending Restart] Brilliance Aura now has a global cooldown.
Fixed an issue where Arcane Blast (Divine) from the Prophet of Wrath legendary enchant dealt slightly more damage than intended at level 60.
[Dark Surgeon] Dark Tranfusion now deals Holy Damage. This will allow the spell to critically strike and result in higher base damage.
[Beast and Blade] Fixed an issue where Blade Beast was not granting your pet 4% Attack Power instead of 5%.
[Beast and Blade] Fixed an issue where Blade Beast was not granting your pet 5% of your agility. (Pending Restart).

[Beast and Blade] Fixed an issue where Blood Focus, Plan of Attack and Beastly Followup would sometimes stop proccing until you re-equipped the enchant. (Pending Restart. You can temporarily fix this issue by re-equipping the enchant).

7.description: [Pending Restart] Flash of Adrenaline now resets the cooldown of Sprint when Adrenaline Rush expires, instead of when it's used. (In the new rarity system and together with the new Charge recast mechanic, this RE was a bit too powerful with multiple slow clears and strong chase potential.)

[Pending Restart] Guerilla Trapper's Barbed Snare Trap's stun effect is now on the controlled stun diminishing return category (as most other stuns), changed from being on the random stun diminishing return category.

[Evoker] Evoker has been reworked:

Casting Arcane Missiles while Missile Barrage is active increases the chance to proc your next Brain Freeze by 60%.

Casting Fireball while Brain Freeze is active increases the chance to proc your next Missile Barrage by 60%.

Consuming these effects grant you a stack of Evoker which decreases the cast time of Frostbolt by 3% and causes Frostbolt casts to increase the damage of your Fireball and Arcane Missiles by 3% and the critical strike chance by 3%. Both effects stack up to 5 times and last for 10 seconds.
Fixed an issue where Beast and Blade was not applying its PvP modifiers correctly.

6.description: [Malganis] [Stratholme] Corrected an issue where Skeletal Guardians used a set of unintended spells, inflicting much more damage then intended.

0.description: Added rough arrows and light shot to vendors in Deathknell.
Corrected an issue where creatures of the Paladin Class Type with level 66 had much more health then intended.
Added addition level appropriate green loot to level scaled starting 1-20 zones. Only the first 2 zones for each race are scaled.
[Alar] [Area 52] Fixed an issue in Level scaled dungeons where Healers were doing way more threat than intended.

7.description: [Arcane Gunslinger] Fixed an issue where the Physical Damage from the Gunslinger Barrage was not benefitting from Munitions Expert Armor-Piercing rounds buff.

0.description: [Pending restart] Fixed another 22 NPC spells to no longer silence/interrupt players through Mana-Forged Barrier or other effects that give immunity to interrupt/silence effects.
Improved Mystic Enchanting UI to more clearly delineate what each currency and UI element does.
Attacking opposite faction guards while in PVE mode will now properly flag you for PVP.
Fixed some issues where Temporal Contracts would give you an error on use.
Corrected over 282 different spells from dungeons as far as Scarlet Monastery to Scholomance that could interrupt and silence through mana-forged barrier.
Temporarily removed the tainted scar cache in blasted lands.

2.description: [League High Risk] Increased the drop rate of Homicite from High-Risk mining nodes by 50%.
[League High Risk] Increased the drop rate of Sanguine Root, Thorn and Lotus from High-Risk herbs by 50% to account for the faster pace of League release and need for consumables.

[League High Risk] These adjustments to drop rates in Darkwhisper Gorge are designed to promote it as the end-game High-Risk 1v1 area, ensuring Outlaw players do not lose effective farming power by opting out of For the Horde/Alliance loot bonuses and you have the maximum number of possible targets to engage in PvP.

[League High Risk] These adjustments to drop rates in Tainted Scar are designed to promote Group PvP in Tainted Scar by encouraging players to group safely with other members of their faction to encourage fights between Alliance, Horde and Outlaw groups.
[League High Risk] Significantly increased the drop rate of Molten Essence in Darkwhisper Gorge for all players.
[League High Risk] Reduced the bonus drop rate of Molten Essence in Darkwhisper Gorge for For the Horde/Alliance.
[League High Risk] Increased the drop rate of Molten Essence in Tainted Scar for all players.
[League High Risk] Increased the drop rate of Molten Essence in Tainted Scar for For the Horde/Alliance players significantly to promote group PvP between Horde vs Alliance vs Outlaws.
[League High Risk] Core Forged mobs now deal 25% more damage, reduced from 50%.
[League High Risk] Core Forged mobs now have 75% increased health, reduced from 150%.

5.description: [League High Risk] Sanguine Gear now requires 2 Molten Essence instead of 5, and requires 3 Essence of Blood instead of 10.

[League High Risk] Battle Scarred Leather Straps, Homicite Buckle, Profane Thread and Sanguine Lacquer now require 1 Generic and 1 Specific material to craft, from 10 and 5. This will make Sanguine Gear more reasonable to craft with the pace of League's release schedule. (Restarts restart and spell patch for ingredient costs to update)
[League High Risk] Materials used to craft Sanguine gear will no longer be listed as quest items. Clear your cache and they will become tradable again.

1.description: [Hoplite] As a direct result of the above change: Shield Strike no longer has a cooldown.
Ruthlessness Rare Mystic Enchant now has a 6 second internal cooldown.

[Dark Surgeon] Your damaging rogue finishers have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Trauma Care, reducing the mana cost of Greater Heal and Flash by 15%. Greater Heal consumes all stacks to reduce the cast time by 33% and deal 15% increased Healing. Stacks up to 3.
[Dark Surgeon] Increased the range of Lesser Circle of Healing to 30 yards, increased from 15 yards.
[Dark Surgeon] Reduced the mana cost of Dark Transfusion by 50%.
[Dark Surgeon] Increased the scaling of Dark Transfusion’s damage, but reduced the healing to account for it always benefitting from Hippocratic Oath.
[Dark Surgeon] Hippocratic Oath is now a permanent buff, increasing your healing power by 20% of your attack power, but reducing healing received by 30%.
[Tree of Wrath] Living Lightning cooldown reduction can now trigger for each target critically healed by Chain Heal or Living Lightning. Previously it could only trigger once per cast.
[Wind Rager] Fixed a bug where Rising Winds was not properly increasing Wind Strike Damage. Lowered the intended value to 2%. This results in overall increase in damage per stack.
[Wind Rager] Rampant Tornado now increases Wind Strike damage by 20%.
[Wind Rager] Fixed a visual only error where Rampant Tornado stated it gave 40% attack speed instead of 30%.

[Astral Bomber] Solar Bomber and Lunar Bomber now grant 3% per stack, but now only stack up to 5. This change will significantly increase the viable ways to build Astral Bomber while resulting is a significant DPS increase.
[Astral Bomber] Removed the duration from Solar Bomber and Lunar Bomber to allow preserving ramp up between pulls.

[New Legendary Mystic Enchant] [Beast and Blade]Your combo point generating rogue abilities grant your pet a stack of Blade Beast, granting your pet 5% of your attack power and agility, increasing your pet’s damage by 10% and reducing their damage taken by 5%. Stacks up to 5.
Hemorrhage grants Blood Focus. Causing you to gain 5 energy when your pet deals damage with a special attack.
Your damaging rogue finisher moves have a 20% chance per combo point to cause your pet’s next 2 special attacks to deal 50% more damage. Additionally, you have a 20% chance per combo point to grant a stack of Plan of Attack. Stacks up to 3. 
Dispatch consumes all stacks of Plan of Attack to increase your pets special attack damage by 80% per stack consumed for 5 seconds.

[New Legendary Mystic Enchant] [Disciple of the Tides] Chain Heal no longer consumes your Riptide.
Your Shaman Critical Heals reduce the active cooldown of your penance by 1 second and grant you a stack of Disciple of the Tides. Disciple of the Tides increases the damage or healing of your next Penance by 5% of your healing power per stack. Stacks up to 5.
Your Penance strikes grant you a charge of Tidal Swell. You can store 5 charges of Tidal Swell at a time.
Lesser Healing Wave also teaches you Tidal Shield. Tidal Shield heals your target and applies an absorb shield for 5 seconds for 50% of the healing done(10% for full overheal). Additional casts will increase the absorb effect up to 35% of your targets max health. Requires a charge of Tidal Swell to cast.

0.description: Fixed an issue where Magmadar was dropping Molten Tunic instead of the Tier Tokens for Tier 1.
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where the Hero Architect would say you have too many spells of a certain quality while creating leveling builds.

[Requires Launcher Update] Added an additional button to the Hero Architect allowing you to continue editing the last build you were editing. This will persist through reloading UI, relogging, navigating away, etc..
Create Soulstone is now a 2 Uncommon down from Rare.
Rebirth is now a 2 Uncommon down from Rare.
Majordomo will now also drop a Personal Loot cache on Heroic and Normal flex difficulties.

2.description: [High-Risk] The ilvl requirement to obtain Molten Essence has been reduced to 62 based on your feedback and BiS PvP gear not always aligning with reaching 65 ilvl. The Core Forged tooltip will not reflect this change until next patch.

7.description: [Spell Shredder] The required nerf to Single Minded Fury affected Spell Shredder more than intended. To address this, we increased the base damage and scaling of Elemental Shredder Mortal Strike damage significantly. This change should result in an overall performance increase compared to pre-nerf performance.

Fixed an issue where the tooltip and rank of Unbounded Drain Life was updated to epic. This change was meant to be apart of a bigger rework for the unbounded legendary REs that was unfinished but snuck its way into the live realm with the recent massive RE updates.

6.description: [Area 52] [Sethekk Halls] Player are now able to summon Anzu the Raven God if they have obtained the Essence-Infused Moonstone on Heroic and Mythic difficulty.

8.description: [Area 52] [Swift Flight Form Quest] Swift Flight Form is not awarded as of now. Player that complete the quest line will be able to learn Swift Flight Form at a later time.
[Area 52] [Swift Flight Form Quest] Player are now able to complete the quest Vanquish the Raven God to obtain the Essence-Infused Moonstone to summon Anzu the Raven God.
[Area 52] [Swift Flight Form Quest] Player are now able to accept and start the quest Morthis Whisperwing from Loganaar in Nighthaven if the player has the required reputation and riding skill.

2.description: [High-Risk] Significantly Increased the drop rates of Molten Essence from Core Forged mobs.

0.description: [Pending Restart] You will no longer lose your Munitions Expert buff (armor piercing rounds or quick-draw arrows).
Fixed a long-term client crash on Ascension where relogging or getting disconnected in a raid would cause your client to crash on login. This will require you to update your patch via the launcher.
Necrotic application now has an ICD of 2 seconds per application after gaining more than 10 stacks of Necrosis.
Fixed an issue where Divinity could not be ranked up on Area 52. This fix requires a patch update!
Fixed an issue where creatures looted by a loot bot could not be skinned.
Static Shock Capstone will now refresh the duration of Lightning Shield to Max Duration if you gain charges via the Static Shock capstone.

7.description: [Area 52] [Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where Relentless was not visible.

[Lucifur] Charred bite combo point scaling has been adjusted to favor casting with full 5 combo points. Casting Charred bites with 5 combo points should deal slightly more damage than before but casting with less than 5 combo points will have reduced scaling. This change prevents unintended and unbalanceable interactions and should not affect anyone using the combo point spender as intended.

[White Walker] Winds of Winter's combo point scaling has been adjusted to favor casting with full 5 combo points. Casting Winds with 5 combo points will deal the same damage as before, but casting with less than 5 combo points will have reduced scaling. This change will prevent an unintended and unbalanceable interaction and should not affect anyone using the mechanics as intended.

6.description: [Area 52] [The Slave Pens] Player can now free and obtain Naturalist Bites Mark without having a quest requirement. Mark of Bite now also increases players Movement Speed by 30% and Nature resistance by 140 up from 70.
[Area 52] [The Underbog] [Mekgineer Steamrigger] [Pending Restart] Mekgineer Steamrigger once again uses his Heroic and Mythic version of the Defensive Matrix.

[Area 52] [The Underbog] [Mekgineer Steamrigger] [Pending Restart] The Steam Powered All Purpose Cannon now has an Auto Repair mode, causing the cannon to go into maintenance if low on health. During its maintenance the cannon is not able to operate.
[Area 52] [The Underbog] [The Blackstalker] [Pending Restart] Removed a spamy lightning visual casted from the Blackstalker onto Ball Lightnings.
[Area 52] [The Underbog] [The Blackstalker] [Pending Restart] Reduced the time until Ball Lightning explode to 4 seconds down from 12 seconds.
